Independent .NET Framework CLR 4.0.30319.42000 oracle for real IEnumerable<int>/IEnumerator<int>, foreach, nested finally scopes and LINQ. The original Pascal compiler is never invoked. C# and Windows PowerShell 5 are development tools excluded from portable application packages.

Regenerate with Windows PowerShell 5 and native/tests/reference/generate-user-enumerables.ps1. The TSV contains 1161 executions: 43 scenarios, lengths 0/1/3 and nine fixed flag combinations 0/1/2/4/8/16/10/12/24. SHA-256 after normalizing CRLF to LF: c7864f648171b22d89d31027974522c5b19fe717e35d40a317d08cb2d3099a23. Columns: scenario, length, flags, exact trace, final error code (or ok).

The source logs GetEnumerator, MoveNext, Current and Dispose; each GetEnumerator creates a fresh real cursor. Flags inject faults in acquisition, moving, reading, disposal and callback/loop bodies. DivideByZeroException maps to E_DIV_ZERO, IndexOutOfRangeException to E_BOUNDS, and empty/multiple InvalidOperationException to E_EMPTY/E_MANY. No expected trace is predicted by the native tests.

Scenarios cover full/broken/continued/nested foreach, early function returns, Count/ToArray/Any/First/Last/Single/Sum/Average/default/indexed queries, Take/Skip/Reverse, Select/Where/SelectMany/Zip/Concat/TakeWhile/SkipWhile, SequenceEqual, predicate queries, ToDictionary and List/HashSet constructors. Combinations exercise inner and outer disposal faults, errors that replace pending failures, raw manual enumerators, and the legacy unary Select/Where retry when their source Dispose throws.

The native Pascal fixture mirrors the source protocol with known closed types and real class methods. It computes result values before writing the result marker, avoiding unrelated Write argument-evaluation differences. One compiled native program is executed with fresh per-row inputs and state. Native assertions additionally check inherited named interfaces, class/interface reference identity and casts, known result/element signatures, records, interface-typed foreach elements, static failures before output, boxing, malformed metadata, native callback stack limits, cancellation, allocation/instruction exhaustion, real file writes and closure in Dispose, a bounded infinite Sleep during unwind, and immediate Halt semantics.

Native provider internals that defer producing a yield value until sequence_at retain their previous eager-production checks; raw user Count/Any/Skip/indexed queries follow the observable IEnumerator Current protocol. User generics, explicit interface-qualified implementations, class inheritance, nongeneric interfaces/boxing, variance, general user exception syntax and source-unit loading remain separate work. This is not a complete bin/Lib migration.
